title: Smoky turkey and peppers with parsley rice

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Rice, turkey mince, fresh vegetables, smoked paprika and parsley are all plain whole foods with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: Needs only a lidded saucepan, a frying pan and a sieve, and uses simple frying and absorption-method rice.

works.reason: 300g rice to 600ml water is a sound ratio, 500g mince with three peppers suits four, and the paprika, garlic and burst tomatoes should give enough flavour and sauce.

honest_times.reason: The prep (three peppers, an onion, garlic, 250g cherry tomatoes and parsley) plus about 20 minutes of frying fits roughly 25 minutes hands-on, with the rice cooking alongside.

honest_ingredients.reason: Each name matches its id, every listed ingredient is used, and the water split of 600ml plus 50ml adds up to the 650ml listed.

seasonal_feel.reason: Charred July peppers, cherry tomatoes and fresh parsley make a light, quick summer supper with the peppers at the centre.

plain_voice.reason: Clear, friendly British English with useful cues such as leaving the mince alone so it browns.

hearty_healthy.reason: Lean protein, plenty of vegetables and rice make a balanced family dinner people would happily cook again.
